lines.zh: 挥舞着铁斧，沉重的脚步声回荡在地下世界。
lines.en: Swinging the iron axe, heavy footsteps resound in the underground world.

lines.zh: 每一步都似乎在寻找战斗的痕迹。
lines.en: Every step seems to be searching for battle signs.

lines.zh: 生锈的铁斧随行，锋利却带着岁月的痕迹。
lines.en: The rusty iron axe follows, sharp but marked by time.

lines.zh: 铁斧在手中挥舞，发出铿锵有力的声音。
lines.en: The iron axe swings, making a powerful sound.

lines.zh: 他的眼神中透出贪婪和渴望。
lines.en: His eyes shine with greed and desire.

lines.zh: 在矿石丰富的洞穴中徘徊。
lines.en: Roaming in caves rich with minerals.

lines.zh: 铁斧在月光下闪烁着冷冽的光芒。
lines.en: The iron axe glitters with cold light under the moon.
Swinging the iron axe, waiting for a fight.

lines.zh: 他的步伐中透露出不屈的意志。
lines.en: His gait betrays an unyielding will.

lines.zh: 铁斧的重量让他显得格外沉重。
lines.en: The weight of the iron axe makes him seem especially heavy.

lines.zh: 斧刃刮过石壁，拉出一道白痕。
lines.en: My axe blade scrapes the stone, leaving a white line.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，斧子举得更高。
lines.en: I drag one leg and hold the axe higher.

lines.zh: 安静地站在洞穴入口，等待着猎物。
lines.en: Standing quietly at the cave entrance, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中流露出饥饿与耐心。
lines.en: His eyes reveal hunger and patience.

lines.zh: 铁斧被紧紧握在手中，随时准备战斗。
lines.en: The iron axe is tightly gripped, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 它在洞穴中缓缓移动，寻找猎物。
lines.en: It moves slowly in the cave, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 铁斧偶尔在石墙上留下锈迹。
lines.en: The iron axe occasionally leaves rust marks on the walls.

lines.zh: 等待着一个合适的时刻发起攻击。
lines.en: Waiting for a suitable moment to attack.

lines.zh: 铁斧握在他手中，似乎比他更重。
lines.en: The iron axe, in his hand, seems heavier than he is.
I stand my axe by my foot and wait.

lines.zh: 铁斧偶尔发出微弱的回声。
lines.en: The iron axe occasionally emits a faint echo.
Silently waiting for prey to appear.
Staring at you, ready to attack at any moment.
The iron axe tightly gripped, eyes threatening.

lines.zh: 它的目光紧锁着你的位置。
lines.en: Its gaze is fixed on your position.
Ready to charge at you.
The iron axe points at you, full of hostility.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脖子，掂了掂斧。
lines.en: I stare at your neck and heft the axe.
The iron axe is ready to slice at you.
It's tightly focused on you, looking for an opportunity.
The iron axe points at you, ready to attack.
The axe blade reflects where you stand.
Axe Zombie is hurt!
The iron axe hits me!

lines.zh: 斧刃在我胸口留了个口子。
lines.en: The axe blade left a gash across my chest.
A hole appears on me!
The iron axe wounds me badly!
I got hit by an axe!
Axe Zombie is in pain!
Wounds are increasing on me!
The axe hurts me badly!
The axe breaks my bones!
Smell the iron!

lines.zh: 你身上有我的斧头味道？
lines.en: You smell like my axe.
Got some iron?
Care to show me your armor?
Your sword seems better suited to me.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢分享我的斧头。
lines.en: I don't share my axe.
Your armor for something?
Don't try to take my axe.
I need better weapons.

lines.zh: 你似乎有我想要的东西。
lines.en: You seem to have what I want.
I turn my axe sideways; stop pushing.
Get out of my way!

lines.zh: 我不喜欢别人挡我的路。
lines.en: Don't block my path.

lines.zh: 我抬斧，木柄在你眼前晃。
lines.en: I raise the axe; the haft sways before your eyes.
Move, you block my path.

lines.zh: 别挡我的路，否则会有后果。
lines.en: Don't block my path.
Move, or I'll have to force you.
Don't block my path.

lines.zh: 滚开，我有更重要的事要做。
lines.en: Move, I have important things to do.
Move, don't anger me.
Finding a mate is crucial.
Seek a new home together.

lines.zh: 我们需要一个共同的家。
lines.en: We need a common home.

lines.zh: 我这把铁斧，也想有个伴。
lines.en: Even this iron axe wants company.
Survive together.
Finding our kind is important.

lines.zh: 我们互相帮助，生存下去。
lines.en: Help each other to survive.
Face the world together.
Fight together.
Find a safe place.

lines.zh: 握着铁斧的Axe Zombie出现了。
lines.en: Axe Zombie with an iron axe emerges.

lines.zh: 铁斧僵尸握着他的战利品。
lines.en: Axe Zombie holds his trophy.
Axe Zombie with an axe.
The axe makes Axe Zombie more formidable.
The iron axe in Axe Zombie's hand.
Axe Zombie advances with an axe.
Axe Zombie carries an axe.
Axe Zombie grips the axe tightly.
Axe Zombie swings the axe.

lines.zh: Axe Zombie手中的铁斧闪着光。
lines.en: The axe in Axe Zombie's hand gleams.
Axe Zombie sights the target.
Axe Zombie targets the prey.
Axe Zombie searches for the next target.
Axe Zombie spots the enemy.
Axe Zombie locks onto the prey's location.
Axe Zombie sights a player.
Axe Zombie prepares to attack.
Axe Zombie aims at the target.
Axe Zombie targets the player.
Axe Zombie is about to attack.

lines.zh: 斧头比我先闻到你的血。
lines.en: The axe smells your blood before I do.
You smell of iron.

lines.zh: 这次我带了斧，不是空手。
lines.en: This time I carry an axe, not bare hands.

lines.zh: 我把斧柄在掌心转了半圈。
lines.en: I turn the haft half a circle in my palm.
Twenty hearts is enough for a few swings.
Axe Zombie stares at you.
Axe Zombie looks at you.
Axe Zombie tracks your movement.
Axe Zombie fixes on you.
Axe Zombie watches you.
Axe Zombie targets your weakness.
Axe Zombie locks onto your position.
Axe Zombie looks in your direction.

lines.zh: Axe Zombie注意你的一举一动。
lines.en: Axe Zombie pays attention to your every move.
Axe Zombie stares at you.
My edge lines up with your neck.

lines.zh: 我抬起斧，像抬一根树枝。
lines.en: I lift the axe as if it were a twig.
You back to a wall and the axe comes closer.
The smell of iron makes my hands shake.
One swing will break your shield.

lines.zh: 你数得清我还有几步吗？
lines.en: Can you count the steps I have left?

lines.zh: 斧头低了一点，为了砍腿。
lines.en: I lower the axe to take your legs.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音越来越粗。
lines.en: The sound in my throat grows coarser.
Swinging the iron axe, heavy blow!
Roar and charge at the prey!
Axe swing, no mercy!
Iron axe in hand, slash away!
Heavy strike, target falls!
Iron axe frenzied, foes can't stand!
My iron axe is over my head!
Axe severing your armor!
Bring you down, enjoy the victory!
Axe through the armor, enemies crumble!
The axe's back smashes your shoulder!
The axe bites into your wooden shield!

lines.zh: 我拖着斧刃拉过你的胸口！
lines.en: I drag the edge across your chest!
The axe is stuck, so I just push!
A broken leg does not spoil this chop!
Two chops, not a single breath!
With iron axe, spawn in ruins!
Rising from the ground, iron axe in hand!
Emerging from the soil, iron axe in hand!

lines.zh: 从石缝中钻出，手持铁斧！
lines.en: Drilling out of the rock, iron axe in hand!

lines.zh: 从黑暗中走出，手持铁斧！
lines.en: Walking out of the dark, iron axe in hand!

lines.zh: 在废墟中现身，手持铁斧！
lines.en: Appearing in ruins, iron axe in hand!
Spawn in underground caves!
Rising from the depths underground!
Appearing in ancient ruins!
Drilling out of the rocks!

lines.zh: 我从土里爬出，手里先伸出斧柄。
lines.en: I crawl out of the dirt, haft first.

lines.zh: 铁斧插在坟头，我拔了起来。
lines.en: The axe stood in a grave mound. I pulled it free.
An old suit of armor stuffed with me.
I climb up from deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 铁斧被火烤热了，握着烫。
lines.en: The iron axe is hot from fire; it burns my grip.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，斧柄断了。
lines.en: I land on stone; the axe handle snaps.

lines.zh: 斧子僵尸受了伤，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Axe Zombie is hurt! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，斧子脱手。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; my axe flies free.
Hit by a projectile!

lines.zh: 魔法烧过的地方，皮都焦了。
lines.en: Where the magic struck, my skin is charred.

lines.zh: 铁斧砸在我身上，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: The iron axe hits me! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 斧子还在手里，雷没劈掉。
lines.en: The axe is still in hand — lightning didn't take it.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我还在找我的斧子。
lines.en: In the void, I'm still feeling for my axe.
